1. Custom Values

Custom values are like personalized settings that you can adjust to make your experience with our snapshot uniquely yours. They give you the power to tailor how the snapshot behaves, ensuring it fits your needs perfectly. Whether it's tweaking configurations or fine-tuning outputs, custom values empower you to make the snapshot work just the way you want it to.

If you go to Settings, then Custom Values, you will see the values we have for you. For each value, you can simply click the three dots on the side of each section to add your own value to the custom values.

Whatever you add to these values will update the entire snapshot with that information, whether it pertains to your website, funnels, automations, emails, and more.

Your Med Spa Custom Values:

1. Appointment Calendar Link

Description: This value holds the URL to the med spa's appointment scheduling calendar.

2. Google Review Link (Continuous Reputation Management)

Description: This value contains the URL for clients to leave a review on Google, aimed at continuously managing and enhancing the med spa's online reputation.

3. After Service Review Request link ⭐

Description: This value holds the URL for a review request page that clients are directed to after receiving a service. This is part of the immediate feedback system.

4. Google Review Link (Review Campaign)

Description: This value is the URL for a targeted campaign to collect Google reviews from clients.

5. Google Review Campaign link⭐

Description: This value holds the URL for a special Google review campaign, which may include incentives or special prompts to gather reviews.

6. Holiday Email Offer

Description: This value contains the special offer details or a URL to a landing page with holiday-specific promotions.

7. Referral Campaign Offer

Description: This value holds the details or URL for the referral program, encouraging existing clients to refer new clients in exchange for rewards.

2. Pipelines

Understanding Sales Pipelines

A sales pipeline is a visual representation of the stages a prospect goes through during the sales process, from initial contact to closing the deal. It helps businesses track and manage their sales activities, allowing them to identify bottlenecks, prioritize leads, and optimize their sales efforts effectively.

Snapshot Pipelines

In our snapshot, you'll find three distinct pipelines tailored to streamline your sales processes:

1. Database Reactivation Pipeline

This pipeline is designed specifically for managing leads generated from your database reactivation campaigns. It helps you track and nurture these leads through various stages until they convert into customers.

Stages:

Offer Sent

Description: The initial offer has been sent to the lead.

Objective: Ensure the lead is aware of the offer and track who has received it.

Lead Responded

Description: The lead has responded to the offer, showing interest.

Objective: Engage with the lead promptly to move them to the next stage.

Appt Booked

Description: The lead has booked an appointment.

Objective: Confirm the appointment and prepare for the consultation or service.

Not Interested

Description: The lead has indicated they are not interested in the offer.

Objective: Mark the lead accordingly and consider follow-up at a later date or with a different offer.

2. Google Review Campaign Pipeline

The review campaign pipeline allows you to track all review requests sent through your review campaign, enabling you to see how many clients left a review versus those who did not.

Stages:

Request Sent

Description: A request for a review has been sent to the client.

Objective: Ensure the client received the request and encourage them to leave a review.

Review Link Clicked

Description: The client has clicked the review link.

Objective: Track engagement and follow up to ensure the review is completed.

Review Link NOT Clicked

Description: The client has not clicked the review link.

Objective: Consider sending a reminder or follow-up message to encourage the client to leave a review.

3. Med Spa Sales Pipeline

The main med spa sales pipeline serves as the central hub for managing all your leads. This pipeline helps you organize, track, and prioritize these leads effectively to maximize conversion opportunities.

Stages:

New Lead

Description: A new lead has been captured.

Objective: Qualify the lead and determine the next steps.

Warm Lead

Description: The lead has shown interest and requires further nurturing.

Objective: Engage with the lead to move them closer to booking an appointment.

Pre-Paid (Needs Scheduling)

Description: The lead has prepaid for a service but has not yet scheduled an appointment.

Objective: Reach out to the lead to schedule their service.

Scheduled

Description: The lead has scheduled an appointment.

Objective: Confirm the appointment and prepare for the service.

Did Not Close

Description: The lead did not convert into a customer.

Objective: Analyze why the lead did not close and consider re-engagement strategies.

No Show

Description: The lead did not show up for their scheduled appointment.

Objective: Follow up with the lead to reschedule or understand their reasons for not showing up.

Canceled

Description: The lead canceled their appointment.

Objective: Engage with the lead to reschedule or offer alternative solutions.

3. Calendars

The Med Spa Appointment Calendar is a vital tool designed to streamline the scheduling process, allowing clients to book services online while enabling staff to manage appointments efficiently. This documentation provides a comprehensive guide on how to set up, use, and manage the appointment calendar for your med spa.

Features

Online Booking: Clients can schedule appointments online at their convenience.

Automated Reminders: Sends automatic reminders to clients to reduce no-shows.

Staff Management: Assigns appointments to specific staff members based on availability and expertise.

Service Management: Allows clients to select specific services or packages when booking.

Calendar Sync: Syncs with other calendars (e.g., Google Calendar, Outlook) for seamless integration.

Client Management: Maintains a database of client appointments and preferences.

Setting Up the Appointment Calendar

1. Accessing the Calendar Setup

Step 1: Log in to your GoHighLevel account.

Step 2: Navigate to the “Calendars” section in the main menu.

Step 3: Click on “New Calendar” to start the setup process.

2. Configuring Calendar Settings

Calendar Name: Enter a name for your calendar (e.g., "Med Spa Appointments").

Timezone: Select the appropriate timezone for your location.

Calendar View: Choose the default view (e.g., daily, weekly) that you prefer.

3. Service Setup

Add Services: Click on “Add Service” to list all the services your med spa offers.

Service Name: Enter the name of the service (e.g., "Facial Treatment").

Duration: Specify the duration of each service (e.g., 60 minutes).

Price: Enter the price of the service.

Description: Provide a brief description of the service.

Service Categories: Organize services into categories for easier navigation.

4. Staff Management

Add Staff: Click on “Add Staff” to include team members who will provide services.

Staff Name: Enter the name of the staff member.

Email: Provide the staff member's email address.

Services: Assign services to each staff member based on their expertise.

Availability: Set the working hours and days for each staff member.

5. Booking Rules

Appointment Buffers: Set buffer times between appointments to allow for preparation and cleaning.

Cancellation Policy: Define the cancellation policy (e.g., 24-hour notice required).

Max Appointments: Limit the number of appointments a client can book in a day.

Using the Appointment Calendar

1. Client Booking Process

Step 1: Clients visit your med spa website and navigate to the appointment booking page.

Step 2: They select the desired service from the list.

Step 3: Choose a preferred date and time from the available slots.

Step 4: Enter personal details (name, contact information).

Step 5: Confirm the booking. Clients receive a confirmation email with appointment details.

2. Managing Appointments

View Appointments: Access the calendar to see all scheduled appointments.

Reschedule/Cancel: Click on an appointment to reschedule or cancel if necessary.

Appointment Details: View details of each appointment, including client information and service booked.

3. Automated Reminders

Email/SMS Reminders: Set up automated reminders to be sent to clients via email or SMS before their appointments.

Custom Messages: Customize the reminder messages to include specific instructions or information.

Advanced Features

1. Calendar Sync

Integration: Sync the appointment calendar with Google Calendar, Outlook, or other calendar applications.

Real-Time Updates: Ensure that any changes made in the appointment calendar are reflected in the synced calendars.

2. Reporting and Analytics

Appointment Reports: Generate reports to analyze booking patterns, peak times, and staff performance.

Client Insights: Gather insights on client preferences and booking behavior.

3. Promotional Offers

Special Offers: Highlight special promotions or packages on the booking page.

Discount Codes: Allow clients to enter discount codes when booking to receive promotional rates.

Best Practices

Regular Updates: Keep the calendar updated with any changes in availability, services, or staff schedules.

Client Communication: Ensure timely communication with clients regarding their appointments and any changes.

Feedback Collection: After each appointment, send a follow-up message requesting client feedback to improve services.

Troubleshooting

Appointment Conflicts: Ensure buffer times are set correctly to avoid overlapping appointments.

Email Deliverability: Check email settings if clients report not receiving confirmation or reminder emails.

Calendar Sync Issues: Re-sync calendars periodically to ensure all appointments are up-to-date.

By following this documentation, you can effectively set up and manage your med spa appointment calendar, ensuring a seamless booking experience for your clients and efficient appointment management for your staff.

Appointment Confirmation, Reminders, no-show, & Cancellation Automation

Understanding Appointment Automation

Automated appointment management systems streamline the process of scheduling, confirming, and managing appointments for businesses. By leveraging automation, businesses can enhance efficiency, improve customer communication, and reduce no-show rates, ultimately maximizing productivity and customer satisfaction.

Snapshot Appointment Automation

In our med spa snapshot, we offer comprehensive automation for appointment confirmation, reminders, no-shows, and cancellations. Here’s how it works:

Appointment Confirmation

When a client books an appointment on the calendar, they will receive an automated confirmation email or text message, ensuring that their appointment is successfully scheduled and confirmed.

Process:

Trigger: When a client books an appointment.

Action: An automated confirmation email or text is sent to the client.

Content: Includes appointment details such as date, time, and service booked.

Appointment Reminders

Prior to the scheduled appointment, automated reminders will be sent to the client to minimize the risk of no-shows and ensure that they are prepared and ready for their appointment.

Process:

Trigger: Set intervals (e.g., 24 hours and 1 hour before the appointment).

Action: Automated reminder emails or texts are sent to the client.

Content: Includes appointment details and any preparatory instructions.

No-Show Management

In the event of a no-show, the system will automatically tag the client accordingly, allowing you to follow up and reschedule as needed to minimize disruptions to your schedule and workflow.

Process:

Trigger: If the client does not show up for the appointment.

Action: The system automatically tags the client as "No Show."

Follow-Up: An automated follow-up email or text is sent to reschedule the missed appointment.

Cancellation Handling

If a client cancels their appointment, the system will update their status accordingly. This ensures accurate tracking and allows for efficient rescheduling or follow-up.

Process:

Trigger: When a client cancels their appointment.

Action: The system updates the client's status to "Canceled."

Follow-Up: An automated confirmation of the cancellation is sent, providing options to reschedule if desired.

With these automated workflows in place, the med spa can enhance client communication, reduce no-show rates, and maintain a well-organized schedule, ultimately improving operational efficiency and client satisfaction.

6. Funnels

Funnels are structured pathways designed to guide potential clients through the process of discovering, engaging with, and purchasing your services. They help in converting leads into clients by systematically presenting offers, collecting information, and facilitating bookings or purchases. For med spas, funnels are especially useful for promoting specific treatments, managing bookings, and handling prepayments.

Snapshot Med Spa Funnels

In our snapshot, you'll find three specialized med spa funnels, each tailored to streamline different aspects of client acquisition and service booking:

Body Contouring Funnel

This funnel is designed for clients interested in body contouring services, allowing them to prepay for the service and then book an appointment.

Features:

Landing Page: A visually appealing page explaining the benefits of body contouring.

Payment Gateway: Secure payment processing for clients to prepay for the service.

Appointment Booking: Integrated booking system for clients to schedule their appointments after payment.

Steps:

Discover: Clients land on the body contouring page and learn about the service.

Prepay: Clients complete the payment process for the body contouring session.

Book Appointment: After payment, clients are redirected to an appointment scheduling page to book their session.

Benefits:

Upfront Commitment: Clients prepay, reducing no-show rates.

Seamless Process: Streamlined flow from payment to booking.

Increased Revenue: Prepayments help secure revenue in advance.

Botox Offer Funnel

This funnel is designed to attract clients to a special Botox offer, allowing them to opt-in without prepaying and then book an appointment.

Features:

Opt-In Page: A page detailing the special Botox offer with an opt-in form to capture client information.

Appointment Booking: Integrated booking system for clients to schedule their Botox appointments without prepaying.

Follow-Up Emails: Automated emails to remind clients of their appointment and provide additional information.

Steps:

Discover: Clients land on the Botox offer page and learn about the promotion.

Opt-In: Clients provide their contact information to receive the offer.

Book Appointment: Clients are directed to an appointment scheduling page to book their Botox session.

Benefits:

Lead Generation: Captures client information for follow-up.

Flexible Payment: Clients can book without the need for immediate payment.

Enhanced Engagement: Automated follow-up keeps clients informed and engaged.

Botox Purchase Funnel

This funnel is designed for clients ready to prepay for a Botox session and then book an appointment.

Features:

Landing Page: A page highlighting the benefits of Botox, client testimonials, and the option to prepay.

Payment Gateway: Secure payment processing for clients to prepay for their Botox session.

Appointment Booking: Integrated booking system for clients to schedule their appointment post-payment.

Steps:

Discover: Clients land on the Botox purchase page and learn about the service.

Prepay: Clients complete the payment process for the Botox session.

Book Appointment: After payment, clients are redirected to an appointment scheduling page to book their session.

Benefits:

Upfront Payment: Ensures commitment from clients, reducing no-shows.

Efficient Scheduling: Streamlined process from payment to booking.

Revenue Security: Prepayments secure revenue in advance.

With these three med spa funnels, you can effectively attract, convert, and retain clients for your body contouring and Botox services. Utilize the structured pathways to enhance client experience, secure revenue, and streamline your operational processes.

Funnel Automations:

Each funnel will be fully automated, with the name of each automation matching the corresponding funnel. Similarly, the funnel forms will be named identically for easy organization. When someone opts into a funnel, they will be seamlessly updated in the sales pipeline, tagged appropriately, and trigger an internal notification for you. Additionally, the lead will receive a personalized text and email with their offer upon opting in. If they proceed to book an appointment through the funnel, the appointment reminder automations will be triggered.

It's important to note that each automation and text message can be easily customized to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a cohesive and personalized experience for your leads.

8. Database Reactivation

Database reactivation campaigns are strategic marketing initiatives aimed at re-engaging with inactive or lapsed leads in your med spa's contact list. These campaigns help revitalize your database, reignite interest in your treatments and services, and ultimately drive conversions. In our snapshot, we offer a tailored database reactivation campaign specifically designed for med spas.

Overview

Our database reactivation campaign offers a unique opportunity to reconnect with dormant leads and entice them back to your med spa. By offering a compelling incentive, such as vouchers for $50 off any treatment priced at $199 or more, you can reignite interest and encourage action among inactive leads.

Basic Database Reactivation Campaign

The basic campaign provides a straightforward approach to reactivating dormant leads in your database. You have the flexibility to customize the offer for this campaign using a custom value. This campaign aims to reconnect with inactive leads, remind them of your med spa's value proposition, and encourage them to re-engage with your business.

Key Features:

Customizable offer: Vouchers for $50 off any treatment $199 or more.

Straightforward reactivation approach.

Aimed at reminding inactive leads of your med spa's value proposition.

Advanced Database Reactivation Campaign

The advanced campaign takes database reactivation to the next level by incorporating dynamic lead management features. Similar to the basic campaign, you can customize the offer using a custom value. However, this campaign goes a step further by updating leads in a dedicated DR campaign pipeline.

Key Features:

Customizable offer: Vouchers for $50 off any treatment $199 or more.

Dynamic lead management: Leads are updated in a dedicated DR campaign pipeline.

Response tracking: Leads are moved to "responded" or "not interested" statuses based on their engagement, allowing you to focus efforts on promising leads.

Implementation

To implement the med spa database reactivation campaign:

Customize the offer: Run whatever offer the med spa wants.

Deploy the campaign: Send out personalized emails or text messages to your dormant leads, offering the voucher and inviting them to book an appointment.

Track responses: Monitor leads' reactions to the campaign and update their statuses accordingly in the DR campaign pipeline.

Follow up: Follow up with leads who respond positively to schedule appointments and provide further information.

Benefits

Reactivation of dormant leads: Reconnect with inactive leads and encourage them to return to your med spa.

Increased engagement: Offer a compelling incentive to reignite interest and drive action.

Efficient lead management: Utilize the DR campaign pipeline to track responses and focus efforts on promising leads.

With our tailored database reactivation campaign, you can effectively re-engage with dormant leads, drive conversions, and grow your med spa business.

10. Referral Campaign Workflow

Referral campaigns are powerful marketing strategies designed to leverage the existing customer base to acquire new customers. By incentivizing customers to refer friends, family, or colleagues to your business, referral campaigns can rapidly expand your customer network and drive growth. In our snapshot, we offer a comprehensive referral campaign feature that enables you to easily create and manage referral programs tailored to your business needs.

Snapshot Referral Campaign

Customizable Referral Incentives: Our referral campaign feature allows you to customize the incentives offered to customers for referring new business. By utilizing custom values, you can tailor the incentives to align with your promotional strategies and budget. Whether it's offering discounts, freebies, or exclusive rewards, the referral campaign feature empowers you to create compelling incentives that motivate customers to spread the word about your business.

Benefits of Referral Campaigns

Expanded Customer Base: Referral campaigns tap into the power of word-of-mouth marketing to attract new customers. By leveraging the networks of your existing customers, you can rapidly expand your customer base and drive growth for your business.

Enhanced Trust and Credibility: Recommendations from friends or family members are highly trusted by consumers. By encouraging referrals, you can capitalize on this trust and credibility to attract high-quality leads and convert them into loyal customers.

Cost-Effective Marketing: Referral campaigns are a cost-effective way to acquire new customers compared to traditional advertising channels. Since referrals come from satisfied customers, the cost per acquisition is typically lower, resulting in a higher return on investment.

With our customizable referral campaign feature, you can harness the power of word-of-mouth marketing to drive growth and success for your business.

11. Incoming Lead Follow Up Workflows

Incoming lead follow-up workflows are automated processes designed to promptly respond to inquiries and messages from potential customers across various communication channels. These workflows ensure that every lead receives a timely and personalized response, increasing the chances of conversion and providing exceptional customer service. In our snapshot, we offer four incoming lead follow-up workflows tailored to different communication channels: Google My Business (GMB) message, email, Facebook message, and Instagram direct message (DM).

Snapshot Incoming Lead Follow-Up Workflows

GMB Message Workflow: This workflow is triggered when someone sends a message through your Google My Business listing. The workflow automatically tags the lead, updates their status in the pipeline as responded to, and notifies the med spa. You can easily customize the messaging and actions of this workflow to suit your preferences and brand voice.

Email Workflow: The email workflow is activated when a lead reaches out via email. Similar to the GMB message workflow, it tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the med spa, ensuring a prompt and efficient response to email inquiries.

Facebook Message Workflow: When a potential customer sends a message to your Facebook page, the Facebook message workflow springs into action. It tags the lead, updates their status, and alerts the med spa, enabling seamless communication and follow-up through Facebook Messenger.

Instagram DM Workflow: The Instagram DM workflow handles incoming direct messages on your Instagram account. It automatically tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the med spa, facilitating quick and effective engagement with potential customers on Instagram.

With our incoming lead follow-up workflows, you can effectively manage inquiries and messages across multiple communication channels, providing timely and personalized responses to potential customers.

Reputation management is crucial for maintaining a positive image and credibility for your med spa business. It involves actively monitoring and influencing how your brand is perceived by customers, both online and offline. In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive reputation management features to help you proactively manage and enhance your online reputation.

Snapshot Automation for Invoice Management

Invoice Reminders Automation: This automation sends timely reminders to customers who have outstanding invoices, prompting them to make payment. By automating invoice reminders, you can minimize late payments, improve cash flow, and maintain positive relationships with your customers.

Cancellation Automation: When a customer cancels a service or appointment, this automation ensures that the cancellation process is handled smoothly and efficiently. Refunds Automation: In cases where refunds are warranted, this automation handles the refund process seamlessly. 14. Missed Call Text Back

The Missed Call Text Back Automation is a proactive response system designed to engage with potential leads who have attempted to contact the med spa business but were unable to connect via phone. This automation sends a text message to the missed caller, providing them with an opportunity to book a consultation or appointment with your business. By leveraging this automation, you can effectively follow up with missed leads and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Snapshot Missed Call Text Back Automation

Engagement Text Message: When a call goes unanswered or is missed, the automation triggers a text message to be sent to the caller's phone number. The message is crafted to be engaging and inviting, encouraging the caller to consider booking a consultation or appointment with the med spa business.

Call to Action: The text message includes a clear call to action, such as a link to your online booking system or a phone number to call back, making it easy for the recipient to take immediate action and schedule a consultation.

Personalization: To enhance engagement and relevance, the text message can be personalized with the caller's name or other relevant details, creating a more personalized and tailored experience for the recipient.
